svg.title: IBM Envizi in three of IBM's figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for Envizi: Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas accounting and reporting, built on the GHG Protocol; five kinds of source captured automatically, ERP systems, IoT and metering platforms, utility providers, spreadsheets and supplier portals; three automated health checks on the data, for completeness, accuracy and timeliness. Each figure is from IBM's own description of Envizi. IBM states no test conditions for them.
